decision: Support module recovery improved: unified ranker, cluster detector, feature normalizer helper, source lineage guard, and program-state multimodality contract are now recovered. Data mining remains closed because extractor/alignment modalities and native telemetry are still missing.
next_best_step: Recover AST/CST, symbol table, import/dependency, type/signature, test/failure trace, and cross-modal alignment contracts before mining /arxiv data.
